draft.emotion: nostalgic and warm, looking back at a fond memory
notes: In northern Vietnam, 'ảnh' (chụp ảnh) is the standard word for a photograph, whereas southern speakers more often use 'hình' (chụp hình).
Common classifiers for 'ảnh' are 'bức' and 'tấm' (e.g., 'một bức ảnh' — a photo).

senses.definition: A picture or portrait taken with a camera.

examples.text: Tôi thích chụp ảnh khi đi du lịch.
examples.translation: I like to take photos when traveling.
examples.emotion: excited and eager to capture a new place

draftBefore.emotion: nostalgic and warm, looking back at a fond memory
notes: Ảnh is a shortened form of hình ảnh, but in everyday conversation, people almost always just say ảnh.
Do not confuse ảnh with hình, which can mean a shape or drawing as well as a picture.

faults.quote: Bóng ảnh của cây in xuống mặt nước.
faults.why: 'Bóng ảnh' is unnatural Vietnamese; reflections in water are 'bóng' or 'hình ảnh phản chiếu'.

faults.quote: (reflection) An optical image reflected in a mirror or on a surface.
faults.why: Standalone 'ảnh' rarely means reflection in everyday Vietnamese; it belongs to compounds like 'phản ảnh'.

faults.quote: Ảnh is a shortened form of hình ảnh
faults.why: 'Ảnh' is a single Sino-Vietnamese word (影), not an abbreviation of the compound 'hình ảnh'.
